newsitem.title: USA: In Focus sees Q1 EPS below expectations.
newsitem.headline: In Focus sees Q1 EPS below expectations.

text.p: In Focus said on Wednesday it expects earnings for the first quarter to be slightly below analysts' estimates at $0.36 to $0.38 per share, on revenues of $64 million to $65 million.
Analysts' on average are expecting first quarter earnings to be $0.40, according to First Call.
The company cited its inability to ramp production sufficiently in March to meet the demand for its newly released LitePro 720 multimedia projector.

President and Chief Executive John Harker said in a statement,""The successful product launch of the LitePro 720 in late February put a significant strain on our supply chain throughout March as we ramped production".
He said that component shortages adversely affected the total number of products shipped in the quarter.
However, he said, "We have today, and expect to maintain throughout the next quarter, sufficient production flow for the LitePro 720 to meet expected demand."
The company said it plans to release earnings on April 10.
